serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Blaubleim’s secretary: Your visit was supposed to take place yesterday…
Fuck…
Blaubleim’s secretary: ...but Dr. has a bit of free time right now and he wants to talk with you.
That’s a little uncharacteristic of him, but I don’t think I’m mentally prepared for this. I just wanted to know the date of my visit!
That was unexpected to say at least.
You: O-ok I guess…{{wi}} but I’m not even near the office!
Blaubleim’s secretary: He wants to talk through the phone.
You: Through the phone? I-is this normal?
Blaubleim’s secretary: Yes.
…
She said it’s normal so let’s go with it.
Blaubleim’s secretary: I'll put you through to Dr. Blaubleim now.
Blaubleim: Hello? Is it you Anon?
You: Yeah. Good morning Dr. Blaubleim.
Blaubleim: Your mother told me that things in your life went…{{wi}} sideways.
Blaubleim: Nothing to worry about son! Happens to the best of us!
You: W-well, I wouldn’t say ‘sideways’...
Blaubleim: Your girlfriend left you, did she not?
You: Y-yes, but that’s not a big deal, really.
Blaubleim: I understand. {{wi}}You are not ready to talk about this at this time. 
…
Blaubleim: Don’t worry! We will have a lot of opportunities to talk about it later! 
Blaubleim: Why did you not come to my office yesterday?
You: Uhm, well…{{wi}} Frankly I didn't know that my visit was supposed to be yesterday…
Blaubleim: Your mother didn’t tell you?
You: No, she didn’t.
Blaubleim: She didn’t huh…
Blaubleim: It’s hard to believe that she simply forgot to tell you the date of a visit even though she was the one who paid for it. {{wi}}Unless something happened…
This guy… {{wi}}His attitude pisses me off…
Now he’s gonna once again analyze my relationship with mother…
You: We had a little quarrel, nothing major.
Blaubleim: Nothing major…{{wi}} Your mother said something different when I last talked with her.
You little rat… {{wi}}Why are you asking me these things if you already know everything?!
You: S-sometimes perception of events can differ from person to person.
Blaubleim: Of course!
Uff… I think that did the trick. Now we can change the topic.
Blaubleim: But sometimes… {{wi}}they differ a little too much.
?
Blaubleim: From my notes I read that…
Blaubleim: ...you told her, quote, to rot in hell, unquote.
This…
Blaubleim: I think we can agree that it was a little overboard.
This nosy bitch!
She even snitched about that to him!
Why does she always have to make my life harder?!
Blaubleim: Hello? Can you hear me Anon? You fell silent for a while now.
You: I-I’m alright! I think the signal broke for a moment, haha…{{wi}} ha…
Blaubleim: All right. 
Blaubleim: So. To what you had such a…{{wi}} strong reaction. What buttons did she push to make you so mad?
You: …The usual stuff.
Blaubleim: I know we talk about your mom many times, but you must be a little more precise. Please, be patient and trust the process.
You: …
You: Many things. She was texting with my ex, she contacted you without my knowledge and was nosy about my new job.
Blaubleim: Woah, that’s a lot to unpack right there!
Blaubleim: Let’s talk about your ex first. What did you feel when you found out that your mom was talking with her?
You: Well, isn’t it obvious from my reaction? 
Blaubleim: Not really. You shouted at your mom while you were confronting her. I’m asking you what you felt at the exact moment you learned the truth.
Blaubleim: Remember! There are no wrong answers in this conversation.
I should tell him my honest feelings. {{wi}}This time lying would just be a waste of money…
